bm120573.inscription_system: archaic cuneiform / Sumerian inscription according to BM; uncertain cuneiform reading according to Gadd
bm120573.gadd_sign_choices: first sign SAG(K) or KA; second KU or possibly LU; third almost certainly SHI; possible fourth uncertain
bm120573.gadd_decision_boundary: Gadd treats the reading as doubtful, says the cuneiform stands alone, and does not use it to read the Indus script.

conclusion: BM 120573 is a real object-level cuneiform route, but it is not an accepted external Indus phonetic anchor in the current workspace: the object has no recorded Indus sign sequence to map, the cuneiform reading is uncertain, and none of the local Ur external-Indus rows maps to the rectangular BM object.
